witness_details.name: Sunita Kapoor

witness_statement.statement_under_section: Section 161 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
witness_statement.statement_text: My name is Sunita Kapoor, and I live in Flat 301 which is adjacent to Flat 302 of the Malhotra family. Today, on 20th November 2024, I was at home the entire day as I was not keeping well. At around 2:25 PM, I heard some footsteps on the staircase but did not think much as I assumed it was someone from the building. Around 2:30 PM, I clearly heard a loud metallic banging sound from the direction of Flat 302. I came out of my flat to check and saw a man in dark clothes bending over the door of Flat 302. When I called out to him asking what he was doing, he mumbled something and said he was from the plumber's team. I got suspicious but went back inside as he seemed to be in a hurry. About 20-25 minutes later, around 2:55 PM, I again heard footsteps and peeped out of the door. I saw the same man carrying a black bag and rushing down the stairs. This time I clearly saw his face. I recognized him - he was Ravi, the former security guard of our building who had been dismissed about two months back. I immediately called the current security guard Mahesh on the intercom to inform him, but the man had already left by then. I did not have Vikram bhai's contact number so I waited for the family to return. When they returned around 7:00 PM and I heard their shocked voices, I came out and told them about what I had seen. I accompanied them when they went to file the complaint at the police station. I can identify the man Ravi if shown to me. He was wearing a black t-shirt and dark blue jeans, and was carrying a black rexine bag. Whatever I have stated is true to the best of my knowledge.

identification_of_accused.identification_details: Ravi, the former security guard - dark complexion, medium height, wearing black t-shirt and dark blue jeans
